claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: WAY-170523 is a weak, non-selective MMP13 inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through MMP13 inhibition; any observed killing would most plausibly reflect a non-specific physicochemical or off-target effect, but the compound is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen.
